title: The Strategic Implications of China’s Military Facility in Laos
author: Ying Yu Lin
text:
A PLA Air Force J-10 fighter takes part in the 2021 International Army Games.
Credit: Russian Ministry of Defense
China inaugurated an air force support and training center in Laos on September 29, marking China’s third overseas military facility. Analysts have noted that the arrangement could expand the People’s Liberation Army’s military presence in Southeast Asia and strengthen China’s regional interests, although there is currently no evidence that Beijing has deployed large-scale forces at the site.According to China’s Ministry of National Defense, the China-Laos Joint Support and Training Center and the China-Laos Friendship Aviation Academy have formally begun operations at Ban Keun Airport. The two facilities are mainly intended to assist in the training of Lao Air Force pilots and will be jointly maintained and operated by China and Laos. Beijing has not disclosed details regarding the number of Chinese personnel or the equipment stationed there.[...]
